first_gate: Real Windows execution of the existing static-window profile
summary: Static-window and interactive-counter links are unqualified cross-links for i686-pc-windows-msvc (PE32), x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (PE32+), and aarch64-pc-windows-msvc (PE32+). Profile sash.win32.interactive/0.0.2 links the counter with one heading, one integer edit, one button, one checked D1 addition, permitted copy, denied paste, Enter activation, and class unregister on close. The i686 image calls SetWindowLongW. The x64 and ARM64 images call SetWindowLongPtrW. Executable launch is BLOCKED on every architecture. Scenes without a gestures block stay on sash.win32.interactive/0.0.1. Two links of the static fixture and two links of the interactive counter on this host produced identical App.exe bytes and identical PDB bytes for x64, i686, and ARM64. Each build report leaves R1, R2, and host_pair unclaimed. The same-host i686 and ARM64 images still embed processorArchitecture amd64, and the current verifier rejects them. One later static link embeds x86 for i686 and one embeds arm64 for ARM64. One later interactive link embeds x86 for i686 and arm64 for ARM64. The interactive i686 image calls SetWindowLongW. The interactive ARM64 image calls SetWindowLongPtrW. Those images were not launched and are not a same-host pair. verify now reports the PE machine and the manifest assembly profile instead of the x64 static-window default. The link also requires that triple's import libraries in the local sysroot.

selected_architecture_sysroot.note: The link requires the import-library directory for the selected triple. A fixture sysroot that contains only x86_64-unknown-windows-msvc fails i686 and ARM64 with SASH-TOOLCHAIN. Sash does not download the missing libraries. This check does not launch Windows.

static_window_link.prior_record_note: Size and entry RVA match the 14 November 2026 record. The SHA-256 does not. Byte-for-byte reproduction was not demonstrated. R1 and R2 remain NOT_RUN.

interactive_clipboard_link.prior_record_note: The prior image linked the same scene before a denied cut dropped Shift+Delete. This scene still does not author cut.
interactive_clipboard_link.note: Copy is allowed. Paste is denied on the edit. Cut was not authored, so the system cut command remains on this image. A scene that denies cut also drops Shift+Delete before the edit changes. Delete without Shift is not a cut. Enter activates the button. Space is delivered to the focused control. Close unregisters the window class. A failed message pump destroys the window first. The result text is written before the value and revision are stored. The count changes only when that text reads back as the new value. A different readback restores the previous result text while the window is live. A nested activation during that write is ignored. A release that starts during that write drops the commit. A failed text update leaves the previous value. The image was not launched.
